title: Enrollment Guidelines: Applications, Approval and Tier Placement for Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Who may apply.** A Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement is available only to a customer profile whose customer type is business. The customer type is read from the applying profile's customer record before the application is taken; an individual customer profile cannot hold an agreement.

**Entry conditions of the tier applied for.** The tier applied for must meet its entry conditions:

- the company's documented annual Crestline spend reaches the tier's annual spend threshold;
- at approval, the agreement's active roster — the distinct travelers added to the roster and not later removed — reaches the tier's minimum enrolled travelers;
- a Corporate tier (Crestline Corporate Select, Preferred, Premier or Strategic) also requires a negotiated contract signed by the company, which only a human representative can arrange.

**Approval and decline.** An application that meets the Crestline Business Connect or Crestline Business Connect Plus entry conditions is approved: the agreement starts on the approval date, and the end of its first term falls the tier's agreement term, in calendar months, after the approval date. An application that meets no tier's entry conditions is declined.

**Moving up.** When the spend in the current agreement year reaches the annual spend threshold of a higher tier, the agreement moves up to that tier from the next day. A move to a Corporate tier additionally requires the negotiated contract.

**The agreement year.** The approval date sets the agreement year: each agreement year runs from an anniversary of the approval date.

### Decision summary

| Situation | Outcome under these guidelines |
|---|---|
| Applying profile is not of customer type business | no agreement is available |
| Application meets the Crestline Business Connect or Crestline Business Connect Plus entry conditions | approved on the approval date; first term ends one agreement term later |
| Application meets no tier's entry conditions | declined |
| Current agreement-year spend reaches a higher tier's threshold, and the higher tier is a Business Connect tier | moves up from the next day |
| Current agreement-year spend reaches a higher tier's threshold, and the higher tier is a Corporate tier | moves up from the next day only with the negotiated contract |

### Worked dates (hypothetical)

- An agreement on a tier with a 12-month term is approved on 14 March. Its first term ends on 14 March of the following year, and its agreement years run from each 14 March.
- On a tier with a 24-month term, the same approval date gives a first-term end on 14 March two years later; the agreement year still runs from each 14 March.
- An agreement's current-year spend reaches a higher Business Connect tier's threshold on 9 October. The agreement holds the higher tier from 10 October.
